tagline: Split one ASIC into multiple virtual miners with pool alternation
description:
SplitMiner is a Stratum proxy that accepts one real ASIC/miner connection
and splits it into multiple virtual miners, each on its own pool or worker.
Uses pool alternation — the miner works on one pool's job at a time,
switching by target hashrate. Includes a web dashboard with real-time
hashrate, share tracking, and CG-API per virtual miner.

First run:

1. Open the app — configure virtual miners (pool URL, worker, optional target)
2. Point your ASIC at `stratum+tcp://YOUR_HOST_IP:3333`
3. Watch shares and hashrate on the dashboard

Features:

- Split one miner into N virtual miners
- Optional per-VM targets in TH/s or % of total hashrate
- Excess above targets routes to OVERFLOW when enabled
- CG-API per VM (ports 4028+)
- Difficulty override for low-hashrate miners

Host ports **3333** and **4028–4030** must be free. If another stratum proxy
is already bound to 3333, the container will fail to start.
author: Carpathians

tips.before_install:
Requires free host ports **3333** (Stratum) and **4028–4030** (CG-API).
The dashboard is on port **8755**.

After install, point the ASIC at `stratum+tcp://YOUR_HOST_IP:3333`.
